title: User
description: Public view of a user. The password hash never leaves the backend.

onboardingCompleted.description: Whether the first-launch walkthrough was finished or dismissed.

emailVerified.description: Whether the email address was confirmed (verification link, password reset or Google). Unverified accounts cannot start simulations.

hasPassword.description: False for accounts created with Google sign-in until a password is set through a reset.

googleLinked.description: Whether Google sign-in is linked to the account.
